title: Small, and the smaller place next door
text: Keene had 469 people at the 2020 census, up from 431 ten years earlier, sitting a little above 2,600 feet in the foothills of the Tehachapi Mountains. A smaller place still, Woodford, about 30 buildings in all, once stood just outside Keene.

s1.title: Keene, California
s1.quote: The 2020 census reported a population of 469 ... up from 431 in the 2010 census ... Elevation 2,602 ft (793 m) ... in the foothills of the Tehachapi Mountains ... A small community, Woodford, of about 30 buildings once existed about 1 mile southeast of Keene.
